name: Ailill Dubdétach
text: Ailill Dubdétach, Ailill black tooth, is the monstrous brother of the fair Delbcháem. In the Echtrae Airt meic Cuinn he challenges the hero Art mac Cuinn. Art kills the ugly brother in that contest. The tale sets a brute against a champion.

attributes.attribute: slain by Art mac Cuinn in the Echtrae Airt meic Cuinn

okr.objective: Record Ailill Dubdétach as a villain of early Irish tale.
key_results: Give the black tooth sense of the name.
Note his death at the hand of Art mac Cuinn.
